fato_historico: 2016: Proxima Centauri b, the closest exoplanet to Earth, is discovered by the European Southern Observatory.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with discovery today, reminding you that vast wonders hide just beyond your current view. Much like the discovery of a neighboring world orbiting a nearby star, you may find that new possibilities are closer than they appear. Consider looking beyond your horizon; it is a good time to explore uncharted territories of your own potential.
frase_do_dia: Even the most distant stars align when you dare to look up.
significado_numero: Represents the harmonious balance of planetary cycles and celestial rhythms.
conselho: Keep your eyes on the horizon and let your curiosity guide your path today.
